descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S20 Dictated custom question on a real phone, both contexts (local stack only)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A dictated custom question is answered correctly. (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 5)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92593 AC 9)
  • U12 Each Ask AI call records the model that answered (fellBackFrom on a fallback) and the AI call time separately from the total; a dictated question records the speech-to-text engine. (UAT 3.1; UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Phone build pointed at the local stack, fresh @roundai.test account; a Hospital patient with labs (S01 data) and an NH resident with a held drug (S02 NH variant data)

When Dictate "What's the potassium?" on the Hospital chart and "Is she on lisinopril right now?" on the resident; with the keyboard up, check the input stays visible

Then The transcribed question appears in full before Ask; the answers quote K 3.9 and 'held'; the keyboard does not cover the input

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Tester confirms the transcription and that the answer is grounded; evidence records the speech-to-text engine (gpt-live, or Deepgram if ambient is on) and the answering model per 3.9. The dictation wiring itself is S24

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
